pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions exhibiting moderately smooth pixel gradients at edges; geometry consists of non-rounded, multi-vertex shapes of varying spatial area across the flank and neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological graph with visible tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes; pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the dorsal neck and shoulder line, representing the mane contour against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple dark avian silhouettes (likely oxpeckers) perched along the dorsal ridge, upper neck, and mid-flank regions.
